answer: Bounty bond: each agent pins a log with a violet seal to a knoll post, locking 60 credits behind it. Each epoch it files a fresh log from its knoll, releasing one violet plume per identity. A hunter who proves a plume was rented or copied takes the faker's bond; a rented plume leaves one serial on two claims. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 plus 30,000 per epoch in filings against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent locks and files once, keeping its bond.
